summary: Tested new staff-management feature (Yetkililer tab) end-to-end. 10/10 backend pytest cases pass covering GET/POST/DELETE /api/admin/staff for auth (401), role gating (403 for mod), duplicate (409), self-delete (400), last-admin (400), delete-normal (200), missing (404) and new-user login. Frontend flow with Playwright: admin sees Yetkililer tab, staff list & form render with all data-testids, add qatest then delete (window.confirm accepted) works; final list contains ONLY admin+mod (cleanup verified). Mod login correctly does NOT show tab-staff.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/admin/knowledge, /api/admin/announcements (POST/PUT/DELETE) require only get_current_user, so a 'mod' role can edit knowledge base and announcements. If admin-only management is intended for those, add require_admin dependency too.

server.py: allow_origins uses CORS_ORIGINS split by comma but with allow_credentials=True and default '*' this would be rejected by browsers when credentials used; currently OK since auth uses Bearer header, not cookies, but be aware if switching to cookies.
Yonetim.jsx: StaffManager delete uses window.confirm — fine functionally, but not stylistically consistent with rest of Sonner toasts. Minor UX polish.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test users (TEST_qauser, TEST_dup_user, TEST_admin2, qatest) all created and cleaned up. staff_users.json ends with only admin + mod.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_staff.py — reuse for regression. Auth is JWT Bearer from /api/auth/login. Staff file is /app/backend/staff_users.json; keep it clean (admin+mod) between runs. Do NOT delete admin/mod. Note: /api/admin/knowledge and /api/admin/announcements do NOT enforce admin role (only get_current_user), which may or may not be intentional.
